title: 勾选的技能进了提示与 skill_read，未勾选的文件读不到
notes: What this proves end to end: PUT /v1/settings accepts one tick; the next root request's system prompt carries that skill's index line; a scripted model calls skill_read and the tool result carries the file's own sentence; the following model request carries it too; a second SKILL.md that really exists on disk but was never ticked is refused with an error result naming the selection, and its text never reaches a row. What it does not prove: the model's own choice (it is scripted), the 技能 page's push (the settings PUT stands in for it), and the CLI path (that is cli-chat). The prompt index is asserted here from the request the daemon actually sent, and covered deterministically in apps/bots/test/runtime/skills.test.ts.
